{{Quote|There's got to be something you need. Something you want. I have connections, many connections in the city. I can provide high-quality unique weapons that you won't be able to find elsewhere. I even have a rare lightsaber crystal&mdash;something you'd never find elsewhere. If you need money, I'll pay you 5000 credits. All I ask is get me one open starport visa.|Sakarie, to Meetra Surik|<ref name="KOTORII" />}}'''Sakarie''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="KOTORII" /> criminal and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived a thriving life of crime.<ref name="Guide">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> During the [[Dark Wars]],<ref name="CAMP">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> she did transport work for the criminal [[Exchange]] organization and was in possession of a rare [[Qixoni crystal/Legends|Qixoni crysta]]<nowiki/>l used in the constuction of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].<ref name="KOTORII" /> 

In [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' to [[3951 BBY]].</ref> she was in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] on<ref name="KOTORII" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CAMP" /> [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]],<ref name="KOTORII" /> tasked to transport [[Permacrete/Legends|permacrete]] explosives for the Exchange, who would use the devices to permanently deal with competition and local authorities. Sakarie, however, could not leave the city without a [[starport visa]], a result of the ongoing [[Onderon Civil War]]. While the [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]<ref name="KOTORII" /> [[Meetra Surik]]<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> visited Iziz on a [[Blockade of Onderon|search]] for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kavar]], Sakarie spent [[Time/Legends|time]] in the [[Unidentified Iziz cantina|cantina]] in the city's western square.<ref name="KOTORII" />
